outcome: cytokine levels (IL-8, IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-10, tumor necrosis factor alpha, IL-12)
cohort: The cohort consisted of neonates from whom cord blood was collected after full-term vaginal or cesarean delivery, categorized into a maternal DM group (n=8) and a non-DM control group (n=7).
finding: Maternal DM induces excessive inflammatory activation in neonates via a TLR5- or TLR1/2-mediated innate immune response, indicated by higher IL-8 and TNF-alpha concentrations in monocyte cultures from the DM group.
